en-US.description: An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Autodesk AutoCAD, rebuilt in pure Rust
en-US.longDescription:
CADCraft is a fast, open-source, clean-room reimplementation of the AutoCAD workflow, rebuilt in pure Rust: the command line, object snaps, layers, dimensions, hatches, blocks and DXF drawings you already know. It runs natively on macOS, Windows, Linux and FreeBSD, and in the browser via WebAssembly.

What works today
- Command line: keyword prompts, history, AutoComplete, aliases, @dx,dy and @d<a entry, direct distance entry, transparent commands and .scr-style scripts.
- Draw and modify: LINE, PLINE, CIRCLE, ARC, RECTANG, POLYGON, ELLIPSE, SPLINE, XLINE, RAY, DONUT, TEXT and MTEXT, plus ERASE, MOVE, COPY, ROTATE, SCALE, MIRROR, STRETCH, OFFSET, TRIM, EXTEND, FILLET, CHAMFER, BREAK, JOIN, EXPLODE, rectangular and polar ARRAY, draw order and OVERKILL.
- Precision: object snaps (endpoint, midpoint, center, quadrant, intersection, perpendicular, tangent and more), polar tracking, ortho and grid snap.
- Layers and properties: Layer Properties Manager with on/off, freeze, lock and plot states, layer tools, and a Properties palette with per-object editing, linetypes, lineweights and true colour.
- Annotation: all DIM* commands with full DIMSTYLE variables and associative dimensions, MLEADER, TABLE, TrueType fonts, MTEXT formatting codes and a single-stroke drafting font.
- Hatch and blocks: pick-point hatch boundaries with islands, pattern, solid and gradient fills, BLOCK/INSERT, attributes and nested blocks.
- Files and plotting: DXF read/write (R12-2018), DWG read/write (R13-2018), PDF plotting, SVG and PNG export, paper-space layouts, viewports, page setups and PLOT.
- Parametric: geometric and dimensional constraints, AUTOCONSTRAIN, PARAMETERS with expressions and hot grips.
- Automation: an MCP server, a JSON control channel and the cadcraft-cli tool.

en-US.releaseNotes:
Note
FreeBSD aarch64 is dropped from this release. We had to cut releases, and we cannot build this target within the 5-hour CI limit for any of the Craft apps, so we are dropping it for now. This is a known blocker, flagged for a future fix in storytold/craft-common-actions#39. FreeBSD x86_64 and every other platform are included.
What's Changed
- docs: add SonarCloud and CodeRabbit badges to README by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1566
- Skip CodeRabbit reviews on Dependabot PRs by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1727
- ci: switch to shared nix workflow from craft-common-actions by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1398
- security: enforce HTTPS on curl downloads (SonarCloud S6506) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1837
- README: the app icon above the title by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1894
- AutoLISP: = compares the symbols type returns by @Hamza0101 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1628
- AutoLISP: an entsel prompt shows the pick box whatever its message says by @Hamza0101 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1635
- Treat polyline bulges with a sub-EPS sweep as straight segments by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1480
- DXF: keep foreign objects whose handles are above 2^48 (fixes #1773) by @philipp-tch in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1774
- Multileader sizes no longer multiplied by DIMSCALE (#1648) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1678
- DWG: write the current text style's own handle, so AutoCAD opens with it current (#1650) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1680
- io: the four symbol tables honour the same record cap as their peers by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1336
- Control server: wait after a failed accept instead of retrying at once by @oracola91 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1718
- Keep a layout's plot window corners when saving DXF (#1667) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1683
- Write the ACAD_TABLE *T block relative to its insertion point (#1644) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1677
- README: verify official releases and download checksums (fixes #1554) by @C00kieMonsta in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1568
- Use chrono instead of hand-rolled UTC conversion by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1789

- @Hamza0101 made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1628
- @philipp-tch made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1774

- @oracola91 made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1718

zh-CN.description: 用纯 Rust 全新重写的开源净室实现，还原了 AutoCAD 的工作流
zh-CN.longDescription:
CADCraft 是一个用纯 Rust 全新重写的开源净室实现，还原了 AutoCAD 的工作流：你熟悉的命令行、对象捕捉、图层、标注、填充、图块和 DXF 图纸。它可在 macOS、Windows、Linux 和 FreeBSD 上原生运行，也可通过 WebAssembly 在浏览器中运行。

当前可用功能
- 命令行：关键字提示、历史记录、自动补全、别名、@dx,dy 与 @d<a 坐标输入、直接距离输入、透明命令和 .scr 风格脚本。
- 绘图与修改：LINE、PLINE、CIRCLE、ARC、RECTANG、POLYGON、ELLIPSE、SPLINE、XLINE、RAY、DONUT、TEXT、MTEXT，以及 ERASE、MOVE、COPY、ROTATE、SCALE、MIRROR、STRETCH、OFFSET、TRIM、EXTEND、FILLET、CHAMFER、BREAK、JOIN、EXPLODE、矩形/环形 ARRAY、绘图顺序和 OVERKILL。
- 精确绘图：对象捕捉（端点、中点、圆心、象限点、交点、垂足、切点等）、极轴追踪、正交和栅格捕捉。
- 图层与特性：图层特性管理器（开/关、冻结、锁定、打印），图层工具，以及支持逐对象编辑、线型、线宽和真彩色的特性选项板。
- 标注：全部 DIM* 命令，完整的 DIMSTYLE 变量和关联标注，MLEADER、TABLE、TrueType 字体、MTEXT 格式代码和单线制图字体。
- 填充与图块：拾取点填充边界与孤岛，图案、实体和渐变填充，BLOCK/INSERT、属性和嵌套图块。
- 文件与打印：DXF 读写（R12-2018）、DWG 读写（R13-2018）、PDF 打印、SVG 和 PNG 导出，图纸空间布局、视口、页面设置和 PLOT。
- 参数化：几何约束与标注约束、AUTOCONSTRAIN、支持表达式的 PARAMETERS 和热夹点。
- 自动化：MCP 服务器、JSON 控制通道和 cadcraft-cli 工具。
